groups.description_en: US diversified medical-devices, diagnostics and nutrition company (NYSE: ABT).
groups.description_zh: 美国多元化医疗器械、诊断与营养公司。

groups.description_en: US research-based biopharma spun off from Abbott in 2013 (NYSE: ABBV); owns Allergan, Cerevel, ImmunoGen.
groups.description_zh: 2013年从雅培分拆的美国创新生物制药公司；旗下含艾尔建、Cerevel、ImmunoGen。

groups.description_en: UK-headquartered global biopharmaceutical company spanning oncology, cardiovascular, respiratory, rare disease and cell therapy, expanded via wholly-owned acquisitions.
groups.description_zh: 总部位于英国的全球生物制药公司，业务覆盖肿瘤、心血管、呼吸、罕见病及细胞疗法，并通过全资收购扩张。

groups.description_en: German DAX-listed life-science multinational organized into three divisions (Pharmaceuticals, Consumer Health, Crop Science), with wholly-owned cell- and gene-therapy units BlueRock Therapeutics and AskBio.
groups.description_zh: 德国DAX上市的生命科学跨国集团，下设制药、消费者健康、作物科学三大事业部，并全资拥有细胞与基因治疗子公司BlueRock与AskBio。

groups.description_en: The pharmaceutical arm of China Resources, a central state-owned conglomerate, controlling China's largest portfolio of listed pharma and TCM companies through HK-listed flagship CR Pharmaceutical (3320.HK).
groups.description_zh: 央企中国华润有限公司的医药板块，通过香港上市旗舰华润医药（3320.HK）控股中国规模最大的一批医药与中药上市公司。

groups.description_en: Chinese pharmaceutical conglomerate controlled by Cai Dongchen, anchored by HK-listed CSPC Pharmaceutical Group (1093.HK) and spanning innovative drugs, generics, APIs and functional foods.
groups.description_zh: 蔡东晨实际控制的中国医药集团，以港股上市的石药集团（1093.HK）为旗舰，业务覆盖创新药、仿制药、原料药及功能食品。

groups.description_en: Shanghai-listed (and HK-listed) pharmaceutical arm of the Fosun conglomerate, controlling biosimilar, injectables and aesthetic-device subsidiaries across China, India and Israel.
groups.description_zh: 复星集团旗下的A+H上市医药板块，控股复宏汉霖、Gland Pharma等创新药与注射剂企业。

groups.name_zh: 广州医药集团有限公司（广药集团）
groups.description_en: Guangzhou municipal state-owned pharmaceutical conglomerate, China's largest TCM-led pharma group, controlling listed flagship Guangzhou Baiyunshan and the Wanglaoji brand.
groups.description_zh: 广州市属国有大型医药集团，中国最大的中药龙头之一，控股上市旗舰广州白云山及王老吉品牌。

groups.name_zh: 远大医药（中国远大集团）
groups.description_en: Chinese privately-controlled healthcare group whose HK-listed flagship Grand Pharmaceutical Group is ~59% controlled by China Grand Enterprises (ultimately Hu Kaijun), spanning pharma, nuclear/radio-medicine and the Sirtex SIR-Spheres business.
groups.description_zh: 由中国远大集团（最终实控人胡凯军）控股的民营医疗集团，旗下港股旗舰远大医药约59%受控，业务涵盖制药、核药/放射医学及Sirtex SIR-Spheres。

groups.description_en: Wuhan-based Shanghai-listed pharma group (600079), China's anesthetics leader, with subsidiaries including Yichang Humanwell and US-based Epic Pharma; voting control transitioning to China Merchants Group (central SOE) via the 2024-25 restructuring of former parent Contemporary Amperex/Dangdai Technology.
groups.description_zh: 总部武汉的沪市上市医药集团（600079），国内麻醉药龙头，旗下含宜昌人福、美国Epic Pharma等；随当代科技重整，表决权控制权正转向央企招商局集团。

groups.description_en: Global diversified healthcare company spanning Innovative Medicine (pharmaceuticals) and MedTech, headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
groups.description_zh: 总部位于美国新泽西的全球多元化医疗健康集团，业务涵盖创新制药与医疗科技两大板块。

groups.description_en: Swiss multinational pharmaceutical company focused on innovative patented medicines, having divested its generics (Sandoz) and eye-care (Alcon) businesses.
groups.description_zh: 瑞士跨国制药企业，专注创新专利药物，已剥离仿制药（山德士）与眼科（爱尔康）业务。

groups.description_en: Swiss multinational healthcare group spanning pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, controlled via Roche Holding AG.
groups.description_zh: 瑞士跨国医疗集团，由罗氏控股公司统辖，业务涵盖制药与诊断两大支柱。

groups.name_zh: 上海医药集团股份有限公司
groups.description_en: Shanghai SASAC-controlled (via SIIC/Shanghai Industrial) integrated pharmaceutical group spanning R&D, manufacturing and China's second-largest drug distribution network, dual-listed in Shanghai (601607) and Hong Kong (02607).
groups.description_zh: 上海市国资委通过上海实业集团控股的综合性医药集团，覆盖研发、制造与全国第二大药品分销网络，A股(601607)+H股(02607)两地上市。

groups.name_en: Sino Biopharmaceutical (Charoen Pokphand / Chia Tai Group)
groups.name_zh: 中国生物制药（正大/卜蜂集团）
groups.description_en: Hong Kong-listed pharmaceutical flagship of Thailand's Charoen Pokphand (Chia Tai) Group, whose core operating units are Chia Tai Tianqing, Beijing Tide and UK-based invoX Pharma.
groups.description_zh: 泰国正大（卜蜂）集团旗下香港上市的医药旗舰，核心子公司含正大天晴、北京泰德及英国 invoX Pharma。

groups.name_zh: 国药集团（中国医药集团有限公司）
groups.description_en: Central state-owned (SASAC-controlled) pharmaceutical conglomerate spanning R&D, manufacturing, distribution and retail, controlling multiple listed arms including Sinopharm Holding, Tiantan Bio, CNBG and China TCM.
groups.description_zh: 国务院国资委直管的央企级医药集团，业务覆盖研发、生产、分销与零售，控股国药控股、天坛生物、国药中生、中国中药等多家上市公司。

groups.description_en: Israel-based global generics and specialty pharmaceutical company, the world's largest generic-drug maker, listed on NYSE and TASE.
groups.description_zh: 总部位于以色列的全球仿制药与特药巨头，全球最大仿制药企业，于纽交所和特拉维夫证交所上市。

groups.name_en: China Beijing Tong Ren Tang (Group) Co., Ltd.
groups.name_zh: 中国北京同仁堂（集团）有限责任公司
groups.description_en: Beijing-municipal state-owned traditional Chinese medicine conglomerate, founded 1669, controlling listed flagship Beijing Tong Ren Tang (600085) and its HK-listed arms.
groups.description_zh: 北京市属国有中医药企业集团，始创于1669年，控股A股旗舰北京同仁堂（600085）及其港股上市公司。

groups.description_en: Global generics and biosimilars company formed in 2020 by combining Mylan with Pfizer's Upjohn off-patent established-medicines business.
groups.description_zh: 2020年由迈兰与辉瑞普强（Upjohn）合并组成的全球仿制药与生物类似药公司。

groups.description_en: Yunnan SASAC-controlled traditional Chinese medicine giant whose former holdco was absorbed into the Shenzhen-listed flagship (000538) after mixed-ownership reform.
groups.description_zh: 云南省国资委实控的中药龙头，混改后原控股母公司被吸收合并入深市上市旗舰（000538）。
